Ameen Rihani, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ameen-rihani/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ameen Rihani, the author, died 1940 (US (Arab-American writer; poems published in the US); under a Lebanon origin the same life+70 rule gives the same result).

First publication of the text used: 1921 (SE colophon: 'compiled from poems published between 1905 and 1921').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1921, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2016.
- Country of origin (US (Arab-American writer; poems published in the US); under a Lebanon origin the same life+70 rule gives the same result): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1940, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2011.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: poems published 1905-1921; no translator or introducer mentioned
- Wikidata Q471451 (Ameen Fares Rihani), P570 = 1940-09-13
- English Wikipedia 'Ameen Rihani' lead: 'November 24, 1876 - September 13, 1940'
